_comment: OSM source data of the cloud builder (docs/design/map-hosting.md §7e). Any cell is built: its extracts are chosen from the Geofabrik index (tools/cloud/osm_sources.py – smallest country leaf containing cell + 5 km, or the leaves of a border cell, merged after the cut). 'sources' would be PINNED extracts checked first: {id, url, cover: [[west, south, east, north], …]} – a cell whose exact bbox lies inside a cover rectangle is cut from that extract only. None today (owner 2026-10-21: South Tyrol uses the automatic choice like everywhere else). Extracts older than max_age_days are downloaded again; extracts above max_extract_mb are refused.
